sentinel_interface.status: DESIGN ONLY - deliberately not implemented per spec

phase_1_static_readonly.api: int run_sentinel(const std::string& coverage_json_abs_path, const std::string& repo_root, Report* report); returns 0 iff violations empty; stdout-only; no sockets/servers/files-written
phase_1_static_readonly.match_strategy: literal strings (envelope names, test labels), never line numbers - this audit documents how line anchors drift while labels survive
phase_1_static_readonly.wiring: add_test(NAME verdigris_protocol_sentinel COMMAND ...) reading orchestration/tasks/TASK-0091-native-protocol-coverage-sentinel/captures/coverage.json; stdlib-only target
phase_1_static_readonly.guarantees: read-only over repo sources; binds no ports; starts no servers; resource capsule respected

sentinel_interface.phase_2_dynamic_optional: reuse existing ephemeral loopback capsule pattern (session tests bind in-process ports; scenarios bind 6780-6799) driving RemoteProtocolSession through a scripted journey requiring >=1 PresentationEvent/model delta per COVERED row
